records.label: Scope, Exploration and Accountability
records.summary: Decide whether an AI-assisted result is a disposable experiment or a candidate for maintained software. Make the intended outcome, permitted effects and accountable owner explicit before promoting a promising prototype into a longer-lived system.
records.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.

attributes.label: Scope, Exploration and Accountability
attributes.purpose: Choose the working regime and the boundary of delegation.
attributes.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.
attributes.symptom: A promising prototype has no accountable destination.
attributes.selection_hint: Start with a reversible exploration and an explicit promotion decision; add delivery controls when the result acquires real users or obligations.

records.label: Measurement and Operational Learning
records.summary: Connect attempts, human work, waiting, rework and accepted outcomes in a common event record. Compare equivalent work and observation periods, include abandoned attempts, and use the result to identify a specific delivery constraint rather than treating generation activity as delivered value.
records.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.

attributes.label: Measurement and Operational Learning
attributes.purpose: Measure accepted outcomes and the complete work needed to obtain them.
attributes.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.
attributes.symptom: Generation looks faster, but delivery is hard to explain.
attributes.selection_hint: Define the outcome and denominator before collecting more metrics; keep unknown follow-up explicit.

records.label: Delegation, Execution and Stopping
records.summary: Keep an authorized work item bounded while choosing how planning, execution, retries and stopping operate. Separate a replaceable plan from its governing intention, preserve permission and budget limits across restarts, and escalate unresolved meaning instead of authorizing it through another attempt.
records.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.

attributes.label: Delegation, Execution and Stopping
attributes.purpose: Add only the execution mechanism justified by the observed failure.
attributes.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.
attributes.symptom: An agent keeps working without a useful new signal.
attributes.selection_hint: Choose one verifiable item, a diagnostic and a stopping condition before introducing more agents, modes or retries.

records.label: Intentions, Contracts and Specifications
records.summary: Turn a request into versioned obligations, scenarios and decisions that a maintainer can inspect. Expose consequential ambiguity, challenge contradictions, and keep implementation plans and diagnostic scores subordinate to the current authorized contract. Reopen affected decisions when the intention changes.
records.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.

attributes.label: Intentions, Contracts and Specifications
attributes.purpose: Compose specification practices while preserving iteration and decision authority.
attributes.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.
attributes.symptom: A polished specification still hides a decisive question.
attributes.selection_hint: Clarify the question that blocks the next decision; expand the specification only where scope, uncertainty or dependencies require it.

records.label: Architecture, Evolution and Maintenance
records.summary: Evaluate implementation alternatives, migrations and runtime observations against a shared intention. Preserve behavior and ownership while changing structure, record why alternatives were rejected, and check whether another maintainer can make the next meaningful change without avoidable complexity.
records.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.

attributes.label: Architecture, Evolution and Maintenance
attributes.purpose: Assess a change in terms of both its immediate behavior and the next change.
attributes.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.
attributes.symptom: The patch works, but the next change becomes harder.
attributes.selection_hint: Use a bounded alternative or migration to examine a concrete design uncertainty before scaling parallel exploration.

records.label: Security of the Toolchain and Its Effects
records.summary: Define who may perform which operation on which data and target, then enforce the boundary outside the model. Combine dependency provenance, content inspection and controlled tool access while treating a scanner result, a permission decision and application correctness as different claims.
records.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.

attributes.label: Security of the Toolchain and Its Effects
attributes.purpose: Connect scanning, policy and containment without implying a security guarantee.
attributes.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.
attributes.symptom: A clean result was produced through an uncontrolled tool boundary.
attributes.selection_hint: Establish the permitted operations and data boundaries first; use scans as additional signals and review denied or uncertain actions.
attributes.family_name: Security of the Toolchain and Its Effects

records.label: Tests, Oracles and Acceptance Evidence
records.summary: Derive expected behavior from an authorized source that the candidate cannot rewrite. Use reproducible checks, independent negative cases and identifiable evidence bundles to inspect a result, while preserving the distinction between a passing check, complete assurance and an authorized acceptance decision.
records.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.

attributes.label: Tests, Oracles and Acceptance Evidence
attributes.purpose: Protect expected behavior and the provenance of the verification record.
attributes.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.
attributes.symptom: The candidate and its tests agree on the wrong answer.
attributes.selection_hint: Ask where the expected answer came from and who can change it before adding another checker.

records.label: Critique, Review and Trust
records.summary: Make a review objection identify a concrete assumption, defect, source or test. Match scrutiny to the impact of the change and the available review capacity, preserve unresolved reasons, and treat model agreement as a review observation rather than proof that the candidate is correct.
records.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.

attributes.label: Critique, Review and Trust
attributes.purpose: Distinguish useful criticism, agreement and acceptance.
attributes.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.
attributes.symptom: More review comments do not improve the acceptance decision.
attributes.selection_hint: Request evidence for a consequential objection and route the patch to the appropriate owner; reduce admission when review capacity is exhausted.

records.label: Context, Memory and Handoffs
records.summary: Keep instructions, retrieved information, task state and authoritative decisions distinguishable. Attach locators, version scope, ownership and renewal triggers to reusable context so that another engineer can resume the work, challenge its assumptions and retain historical facts without applying superseded rules.
records.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.

attributes.label: Context, Memory and Handoffs
attributes.purpose: Preserve useful information without carrying obsolete assumptions into new work.
attributes.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.
attributes.symptom: A resumed task inherits yesterday's rule as today's authority.
attributes.selection_hint: Record the current decision and its version, then retain only the context needed to explain or verify it.

records.label: Competence, Learning and Mentoring
records.summary: Create opportunities for a learner to predict behavior, diagnose failures, explain invariants and review alternatives in their own words. Retain expert guidance and AI assistance while evaluating understanding and later transfer separately from the immediate success of an assisted task.
records.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.

attributes.label: Competence, Learning and Mentoring
attributes.purpose: Separate successful assisted work from retained human competence.
attributes.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.
attributes.symptom: An assisted task succeeds, but independent judgment remains uncertain.
attributes.selection_hint: Include a specific unaided prediction or diagnosis task; do not infer learning from the assistant's explanation or the completed artifact.

records.label: Coordination, Governance and Adoption
records.summary: Assign owners to work items and shared targets, bound work in progress, and route escalation to the person with the relevant authority. Introduce organizational support and automation according to observed constraints, including integration effort and review capacity, rather than the number of agents or courses delivered.
records.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.

attributes.label: Coordination, Governance and Adoption
attributes.purpose: Make decision rights, work limits and the minimum useful workflow explicit.
attributes.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.
attributes.symptom: More parallel work produces a queue without clear decision rights.
attributes.selection_hint: Identify the constrained owner or stage and cap incoming work before adding orchestration.

records.label: Economics, Infrastructure and Work
records.summary: Compare the complete cost and obligations of obtaining an accepted outcome, including setup, human review, rework, waiting and infrastructure. Record the assumptions and observation window behind an adoption choice, and revisit it when real evidence changes rather than treating automation as a required destination.
records.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.

attributes.label: Economics, Infrastructure and Work
attributes.purpose: Adopt, stop or simplify a workflow using inspectable assumptions.
attributes.limitation: Grouping is not a count of independently validated methods.
attributes.symptom: Coordination and operating cost outweigh the useful result.
attributes.selection_hint: Price a comparable accepted change and state the condition that would justify continuing, simplifying or stopping.
